comparison.objective: Carry a full cup around a laptop and place it upright on a coaster.
comparison.physical_skill: Spill-limited transport, obstacle clearance, and gentle set-down.
comparison.success_condition: Cup upright and still on the coaster without spill, laptop contact, unsafe overflight, or excessive landing speed.
comparison.reason: Tests clearance-aware liquid-vessel transport rather than bimanual sifting, retention, and screen reseating.
